answer_1.quote: We select 11 cross-lingual tasks in XGLUE, which are categorized into 3 groups: single-input understanding tasks, pair-input understanding tasks, and generation tasks.
answer_1.outputs: questions and news titles in multiple languages

answer_2.quote: BLEU-4 score is used as the metric.

answer_4.quote: For tasks QADSM, WPR, QAM and QG, we label the data on a Microsoft internal crowdsourcing platform. Each labeler must learn the guideline and pass the labeling test. Each sample is labeled by three labeler. We only keep the samples with two or three labeler have same label.
answer_4.guideline: Each labeler must learn the guideline and pass the labeling test.
